name: @calyx/client-sdk-go
description: Go client for the Calyx backend and core APIs, with webhook checks.

scripts.test:go1.26: GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*' GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off mise exec go@1.26 -- go test -race ./...
scripts.deps:check: GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*'; export GOPRIVATE; out=$(go list -deps -f '{{if not .Standard}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}' ./calyx ./webhook ./backend) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^$' | grep -v '^github.com/csmarckitus/calyx/packages/client-sdk/go/' | (! grep .)
scripts.generate: cd backend && GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*' go run github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.8.1 -config oapi-codegen.yaml ../../../shared-types/openapi/backend.json || exit 1; ! grep -q '"<nil>"' types_gen.go
scripts.generate:check: tmp=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; cp backend/oapi-codegen.yaml backend/overlay.yaml "$tmp" || exit 1; spec=$(cd ../../shared-types/openapi && pwd)/backend.json; (cd "$tmp" && GOPRIVATE='github.com/csmarckitus/*' go run github.com/oapi-codegen/oapi-codegen/v2/cmd/oapi-codegen@v2.8.1 -config oapi-codegen.yaml "$spec") || exit 1; ! grep -q '"<nil>"' "$tmp/types_gen.go" || { echo 'the generated file has a <nil> value' >&2; exit 1; }; cmp -s "$tmp/types_gen.go" backend/types_gen.go || { echo 'backend/types_gen.go is out of date' >&2; exit 1; }
